chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Cozy Cole, studious and rhythmic
summary: Cozy Cole swung with Blanche Calloway, Willie Bryant and Stuff Smith, and practiced rudiments on a pad between Calloway shows.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
